name: Softmax-GS Rendering Algorithm
definition: A rendering method for 3D Gaussians that uses a softmax-based competition mechanism to handle overlapping Gaussians, aiming to provide order-invariance and smooth transitions at Gaussian boundaries.
summary: Softmax-GS is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method that replaces depth sorting with a differentiable softmax competition mechanism to ensure order-invariance and flicker-free, smooth transitions at Gaussian boundaries.
